Plot gene/feature expression trends across pseudotime

PlotFeatureTrend.Rd

Smoothed expression (or any numeric feature) vs. pseudotime, one facet panel per feature, optionally colored by a grouping variable (e.g. "Sample") to compare trends across replicates or conditions. Equivalent to a geom_smooth() + facet_wrap(~Gene) script run by hand, but feature extraction goes through the same assay/version-safe path as the rest of scSidekick (.nk_feature_matrix(), which is what every other feature-plotting function in the package uses): genes are pulled via the v5/BPCells/sketch-safe .get_layer_data(), and numeric meta.data columns (module scores, cNMF usages, QC metrics, other pseudotime columns, ...) are used directly - both are accepted interchangeably in features.

Usage

PlotFeatureTrend(
  seurat_object,
  pseudotime.by,
  features,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  min_expr = NULL,
  color.by = NULL,
  group.by = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  method = "loess",
  se = FALSE,
  scales = "free_y",
  ncol = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  object_name = "",
  subset_name = "",
  file_name = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

seurat_object

A Seurat object, typically after RunSlingshot.

pseudotime.by

Character. Numeric meta.data column for the x-axis (e.g. "Slingshot_Pseudotime_1").

features

Character vector. Gene names and/or numeric meta.data columns. Each gets its own facet panel.

assay

Character or NULL. Assay to pull gene expression from. NULL (default) uses DefaultAssay(seurat_object).

layer

Character. Assay layer/slot. Default "data" (log-normalized counts).

min_expr

Numeric or NULL. Expression floor applied before smoothing: observations with expression \(\le\) min_expr are dropped so the trend reflects the expressing population rather than being pulled toward zero by dropout. min_expr = 0 removes exact zeros. NULL (default) keeps all cells.

color.by

Character or NULL. Metadata column to color the smoothed trend lines by (e.g. "Sample", to see whether replicates agree). NULL (default) draws a single trend line per feature.

group.by

Character or NULL. Metadata column to restrict cells by (e.g. plot the trend within one cluster only).

groups

Character vector or NULL. Which level(s) of group.by to keep. NULL (default, when group.by is set) keeps all levels.

method

Character. Smoothing method passed to ggplot2::geom_smooth(). Default "loess".

se

Logical. Show the smoother's standard-error ribbon. Default FALSE.

scales

Character. Passed to facet_wrap(). Default "free_y" (expression ranges differ across genes).

ncol

Integer or NULL. Facet columns. NULL auto-picks.

colors

Named color vector for color.by. NULL auto-resolves from PrepObject or Nour_pal.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Directory to save a PDF. NULL (default) walks up to the output_dir stored by PrepObject (respecting AutoSavePlots); pass NA to suppress entirely.

object_name, subset_name

Character. Output file-name prefixes.

file_name

Character or NULL. Base name (no extension) for the saved PDF. NULL auto-deduces.

width, height

Numeric or NULL. Saved PDF dimensions in inches. NULL (default) auto-sizes from the number of facets.

Value

A ggplot object.
